paper_metadata.title: Mechanical properties of high-nickel alloys EP-753 and PE-16 after neutron irradiation to 54 dpa at 400–650 °C

evidence.quote: Short-term mechanical properties and void swelling were investigated for high-nickel alloys PE-16 and three compositional variants of Russian alloy EP-753
since swelling usually exhibits a minimum in Fe–Cr–Ni alloys containing nickel in the 35–50 wt.% range

Both PE-16 and EP-753 suffer from high-temperature irradiation embrittlement (HTIE), with the lower temperature limit of HTIE depending on chemical composition, heat treatment, and irradiation temperature.
irradiation at low temperatures (400, 500 °C) results in hardening, with the degree of hardening depending on the initial heat treatment
the authors' opinion is that the dominant cause of HTIE is related to grain boundary precipitation
